newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Turnover moves up on Saudi stock market.
newsitem.headline: Turnover moves up on Saudi stock market.

text.p: The value and volume of shares traded in the Saudi stock market edged up last week, figures released on Sunday by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) showed.

SAMA, the kingdom's central bank, said 2.2 million shares worth 463.5 million riyals ($123.6 million) were traded in the week ending on Thursday, up from 1.99 million shares worth 400 million riyals ($106.6 million) a week earlier.
SAMA, quoted by the official Saudi Press Agency, said shares of 58 firms were traded, of which 32 rose, 18 fell and eight were unchanged.
The agency said banks dominated trading with 777,562 shares worth 239.5 million riyals changing hands.
Cement shares came next with 670,779 shares worth 128.9 million riyals dealt.
